The urinalysis shows white blood cells, and your ESR is elevated, which strongly suggests inflammation. Did you notice any joint pain in your hands, wrists, or feet, or any history of psoriasis or skin lesions?

REQUEST TEST: HLA-B27, ANA, Rheumatoid_Factor.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome). The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (knee and prior ankle), sterile pyuria (WBCs in urine without significant RBCs), and elevated inflammatory markers strongly supports this diagnosis, likely triggered by a recent genitourinary infection.
